name: fire_status_summary
description: High-level FIRE status: FIRE number, current net worth, progress %, years to FIRE, and Coast FIRE status. Start here. dataFreshness says how old the prices behind net worth are — check it before trusting the numbers.

name: get_net_worth
description: Net worth broken down by category: equities, cash, CDs, real estate, vehicles, and crypto wallets, plus dataFreshness (price age, last import, positions with no price source).

name: get_accounts
description: All custom accounts (cash, savings, brokerage, HSA, crypto, etc.) with type and current value, plus estimated annual interest and the combined HSA balance.

type.description: Only return accounts of this type, e.g. "HSA" (case-sensitive).

name: get_portfolio
description: Imported Fidelity / Plaid brokerage positions with symbol, value, cost basis, unrealized P&L and priceUpdatedAt, plus dataFreshness (price age, last import, positions with no price source).

name: get_cds
description: Certificate of Deposit holdings with bank, principal, yield rate, maturity date, and days to maturity.

name: get_upcoming_events
description: Date-ordered financial events in the next N days (default 90): CD maturities, plus CDs that matured in the last 7 days so they can be flagged for a decision.

name: get_expenses
description: Monthly expense breakdown (housing, food, transport, etc.) with monthly and annual totals.

name: get_insurances
description: Insurance policies (car, home) with the amount and frequency as entered, normalized monthly and annual amounts, and combined totals.

name: get_projection_settings
description: FIRE projection configuration: annual savings, expected return rate, inflation rate, SWR, and time span.

name: get_side_gig_income
description: Side hustle income log grouped by platform with per-platform and overall totals (totals cover every entry; the entries list is capped).

limit.description: Max ledger entries to return (default 200). Totals always cover all entries.

name: get_side_gig_tax_summary
description: Side gig sales rolled up by how each item was acquired (business/resale, personal, gift, free): estimated taxable resale profit, taxable gains on personal items, non-deductible personal losses, and sales still missing a tag or cost basis. Optional year filter.

year.description: Limit to sales dated in this calendar year.

name: get_wallets
description: Tracked crypto wallets: chain, label, truncated address (last 8 chars), USD balance, and last-fetched timestamp.

name: get_concentration_risk
description: Monitor exposure limits (e.g., COIN > 20%).

name: simulate_rebalance
description: What-if: move an amount from one asset class to another (e.g. sell $20k of equities into cds) and see the allocation and diversification score before and after. Pass chaos: true (no soldAsset/amount/boughtAsset needed) to sweep every single-leg move across liquid classes and your top positions at several sizes, scored under bear/base/bull return assumptions net of estimated capital-gains tax, and ranked by a metric you pick. Default returns are placeholders — supply your own in options.returns. Read-only — nothing is traded or saved.

amount.description: Dollars moved (> 0, at most the class balance).

chaos.description: Sweep many scenarios instead of one move. soldAsset, amount and boughtAsset are then ignored.

options.description: chaos only. fractions: sizes to try as fractions of each balance (default 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1). capGainsRatePct: flat tax rate on realized gains (default 15). returns: { bear|base|bull: { <assetClass>: annualReturn }, symbols: { COIN: { bear, base, bull } } } as decimals, e.g. -0.3. rankBy: baseDelta | bearDelta | bullDelta | scoreChange | taxCost | largestPositionPct (default baseDelta). limit: rows returned (default 25). maxPositions / minPositionValue: which top positions are tried as sellers (default 5 / 1000).

name: get_swr_sensitivity
description: Safe-withdrawal-rate stress test: annual withdrawal at the given SWR from current net worth, before and after a market dip, compared with annual expenses (incl. tax drag), plus the same at 3–5% SWR.

marketDipPercent.description: Drop applied to equities, crypto and metals, e.g. 30.

name: get_transactions
description: Categorized spending transactions (CSV imports and Plaid sync) newest first, filtered by date range, category or merchant, with per-category totals for the filtered rows. Supports paging via offset and pagingKey (hash of matched row ids).

offset.description: Rows to skip in newest-first order (non-negative).

pagingKey.description: Hash of matched row ids from a previous page. Required when offset > 0.

name: get_recurring_charges
description: Detects subscriptions and recurring bills from the stored spending transactions: merchants charged at a steady weekly, monthly or annual interval with amounts within 10%. Returns each one with its amount, last and next expected date, and a monthly equivalent, plus monthly and annual totals. Read-only and inferred — the app stores no subscription model.

minOccurrences.description: Only report series with at least this many charges (default 2).

name: get_emergency_runway
description: If income hits $0, how many months until $0 net worth?

name: get_net_worth_trend
description: Actual net worth over time from daily snapshots: latest value, change over 7/30/365 days and since tracking began, plus the daily points (optionally limited to the last N days). Each point carries pricesAsOf/stale (null on snapshots recorded before this was tracked); stalePoints counts snapshots taken on stale prices.

days.description: Only return the last N daily points.

name: get_diversification_score
description: 0–100 diversification score from how net worth is spread across asset classes (cash, CDs, equities, crypto, metals, real estate, vehicles, other), minus a penalty for any single position over 20% of net worth; includes the class weights.
